name: Impression Dahongpao Co Ltd
summary: Based in Wuyishan and founded in 2009, Impression Dahongpao runs cultural tourism projects in China. Its attractions include a large outdoor performance of the same name, the Jingshan Water Show, hot springs infused with tea and Da Hong Pao tea tastings, with tickets sold through distribution partners. The parent company is Wuyishan Cultural Tourism Co., Ltd.
